biography: Robson Granger's story begins not on the pristine circuits of Europe, but amidst the roaring engines and sun-baked asphalt of Brazil's Opala Old Stock Race. Growing up in São Paulo, Robson was practically raised in his father's workshop, a haven for classic Opala stock cars. He spent his childhood scavenging for spare parts and inhaling the intoxicating fumes of high-octane fuel. His first taste of competitive racing came at age 16, when he secretly entered an amateur karting event, borrowing his cousin's kart and winning against seasoned veterans. The victory was a defining moment, cementing his unwavering passion for motorsport. Despite facing financial hurdles and skepticism from the established racing community, Robson persevered, honing his skills in the fiercely competitive Opala Old Stock Race. Now at 27, Robson is on the cusp of a major breakthrough. He's caught the eye of several international racing teams, and his aggressive driving style and raw talent promise a bright future beyond the shores of Brazil. He is determined to prove that raw talent and unwavering dedication can trump privilege and pedigree in the world of motorsports.
drivingStyle: Granger's driving style is a captivating blend of controlled aggression and calculated risk. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and fearless overtaking attempts, often pushing his car to the absolute limit. While some critics label him reckless, Granger's tire management is surprisingly adept, a skill honed through years of racing on the unforgiving Brazilian tracks. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances in the closing laps, demonstrating a remarkable ability to maintain focus and exploit any weakness in his opponents' defenses.

rivalries.reason: A veteran of the Opala Old Stock Race, Vieira represents the old guard that Granger is trying to surpass. Their rivalry is a clash of styles: Vieira's calculated precision versus Granger's raw aggression.

famousQuote: "You can't win a race by being polite. Sometimes you gotta take what's yours, even if it means ruffling a few feathers."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2022 Opala Old Stock Race Championship in a nail-biting final race, overtaking his main rival on the last corner to secure the title.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the 2021 Interlagos 500 while leading, due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential breakthrough victory and leaving him questioning his car setup choices.
